source.note: Scan without a text layer. The PDF includes the cover (printed page 1), the instructions (page 2) and the information sheet (page 10); PDF page n = printed page n. Source file and hash are recorded in sources/maths/manifest.json. Duration 3 hours as printed on the cover.

extraction.method: manual transcription from 170 dpi page renders, checked at 400 dpi where needed

questions.text_md: $2x^{2}-3x-3=0$  (correct to TWO decimal places)

Solve simultaneously for $x$ and $y$ in:

$2y=3+x$ and $2xy+7=x^{2}+4y^{2}$

The roots of an equation are $x=\dfrac{-n\pm\sqrt{n^{2}-4mp}}{2m}$ where $m$, $n$ and $p$ are positive real numbers. The numbers $m$, $n$ and $p$, in that order, form a geometric sequence.

Prove that $x$ is a non-real number.
Calculate the value of $x$.
Show that the sum of the first $n$ terms is $S_{n}=1\,000\bigl(1-(0,9)^{n}\bigr)$.
Hence, or otherwise, calculate the sum to infinity.
Write down the value of $\mathrm{T}_{4}$.
Show that the general term of this number pattern is $\mathrm{T}_{n}=-n^{2}+26n-170$.
Between which TWO terms of the quadratic number pattern will there be a difference of $-121$?
What value must be added to each term in the number pattern so that the value of the maximum term in the new number pattern formed will be $1$?
Determine $\mathrm{T}_{51}$.
Calculate the sum of the first $51$ terms.
Write down the expansion of $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{5000}(2n+3)$. Show only the first $3$ terms and the last term of the expansion.

Hence, or otherwise, calculate $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{5000}(2n+3)+\sum_{n=1}^{4999}(-2n-1)$.

ALL working details must be shown.
Write down the equations of the asymptotes of $f$.
Write down the domain of $f$.
Determine the coordinates of the $x$-intercept of $f$.
Write down the coordinates of the $y$-intercept of $f$.
Draw the graph of $f$. Clearly show ALL the asymptotes and intercepts with the axes.

How many years will it take for an amount of R75 000 to accrue to R116 253,50 in an account earning interest of 6,8% p.a., compounded quarterly?

questions.stem_md: Thabo wanted to save R450 000 as a deposit to buy a house on 30 June 2018.

questions.text_md: He deposited a fixed amount of money at the end of every month into an account earning interest of 8,35% p.a., compounded monthly. His first deposit was made on 31 July 2013 and his $60^{\text{th}}$ deposit on 30 June 2018. Calculate the amount he deposited monthly.

questions.stem_md: Thabo bought a house costing R1 500 000 and used his savings as the deposit. He obtained a home loan for the balance of the purchase price at an interest of 12% p.a., compounded monthly over $25$ years. He made his first monthly instalment of R11 058,85 towards the loan on 31 July 2018.

questions.text_md: (a) What will the balance outstanding on the loan be on 30 June 2039, $21$ years after the loan was granted?

questions.text_md:
After travelling a distance of $20$ km from home, a person suddenly remembers that he did not close a tap in his garden. He decides to turn around immediately and return home to close the tap.

The cost of the water, at the rate at which water is flowing out of the tap, is R1,60 per hour.

The cost of petrol is $\left(1,2+\dfrac{x}{4000}\right)$ rands per km, where $x$ is the average speed in km/h.

Calculate the average speed at which the person must travel home to keep his cost as low as possible.

A and B are independent events. It is further given that:

$\mathrm{P}(\text{A and B})=0,3$ and $\mathrm{P}(\text{only B})=0,2$

questions.text_md: Are A and B mutually exclusive? Motivate your answer.
$\mathrm{P}(\text{only A})$
$\mathrm{P}(\text{not A or not B})$

questions.stem_md: A teacher has $5$ different poetry books, $4$ different dramas and $3$ different novels. She must arrange these $12$ books from left to right on a shelf.

questions.text_md: Write down the probability that a novel will be the first book placed on the shelf.
Calculate the number of different ways these $12$ books can be placed on the shelf if any book can be placed in any position.
Calculate the probability that a poetry book is placed in the first position, the three novels are placed next to each other and a drama is placed in the last position.
